Overview
Welcome to our Development & Renovation page. In partnership with Sigma Builders, our projects focus on restoring historic Chicago buildings while adapting them for modern living. Through careful renovation and infrastructure upgrades, we preserve the character of each property while creating comfortable residences built for long-term quality.

title: Development & Renovation
text:
Approach
Our renovation philosophy emphasizes thoughtful preservation and modern functionality. Each project balances architectural character with upgraded infrastructure and practical design for contemporary urban living.

Create long-term, high-quality rental homes

title: Community
text:
\(\leftarrow\) Back to 2417 N Geneva Home

Located in the heart of Lincoln Park, 2417 N Geneva Terrace offers convenient access to one of Chicago’s most vibrant and walkable neighborhoods. Residents enjoy close proximity to everyday essentials, neighborhood parks, and a wide range of outdoor recreation.
Grocery & Daily Essentials: Trader Joe’s and two nearby Target stores (Clark & Diversey and Clark & Fullerton) are within comfortable walking distance. Larger grocery stores such as Mariano’s are about a 5–7 minute drive, while Costco on Clybourn Avenue is approximately a 10 minute drive.
Cafés & Dining: Starbucks and a wide range of cafés, restaurants, and neighborhood eateries are located along nearby Clark Street and Fullerton Avenue.
Parks & Outdoor Space: The property is close to several well-loved green spaces, including Oz Park, Lincoln Park, and the nearby Lakefront Trail and Lake Michigan shoreline, offering scenic paths for running, biking, and outdoor recreation.
Transportation & Nearby Institutions: The residence is within walking distance of the Fullerton CTA station (Red, Brown, and Purple Lines), offering convenient connections to downtown Chicago in about 10–15 minutes, as well as several CTA bus routes along Clark Street and Fullerton Avenue. The property is also close to DePaul University, and Lake Shore Drive provides easy access to downtown and other areas of the city.

title: 2420 N Geneva Terrace
text:
Overview
Located within the Arlington–Deming Historic District in Lincoln Park, 2420 N Geneva Terrace underwent a full renovation from the end of 2023 to the end of 2024. The project focused on preserving the building’s historic character while replacing aging infrastructure and reconfiguring the interiors for modern residential living. This page documents the redevelopment process, from initial conditions and demolition through construction and final completion.

title: 2420 N Geneva Terrace
text:
Project Story
Originally built in 1881, 2420 N Geneva Terrace required a comprehensive redevelopment to support modern residential use. The project involved selective demolition, replacement of aging structural and mechanical systems, and the full renovation of the interior living spaces. Over the course of roughly one year, the building was transformed from an aging structure into updated residences while retaining its historic identity within the Lincoln Park streetscape. The animation below highlights the transition from the original condition to the rebuilt structure, using the first floor as an example.






Three months of transformation

Replacement of outdated mechanical, plumbing, and electrical systems

Interior reconfiguration for modern residential layouts

title: About Us
text:
Who We Are
Zang & Di LLC is committed to restoring and improving residential properties across Chicago. Our portfolio includes both renovated and actively managed rental buildings, with a particular focus on classic Chicago residences that can be adapted for modern living. We value practical design, reliable building systems, and consistent property care, with the goal of providing residents with homes that are attractive, functional, and durable.

title: About Us
text:
What We Do
Our work includes property acquisition, renovation, leasing, and long-term management. Depending on the building and project stage, our efforts may include:

Restoring historic architectural character
Upgrading interiors for modern residential use
Operating and maintaining rental properties for long-term quality
Providing clear and responsive management for residents

title: About Us
text:
Our Aim
Our aim is to build and operate residential properties that offer both character and reliability. We focus on creating homes that are comfortable to live in, practical to maintain, and positioned for long-term value. Rather than treating each project as a short-term renovation, we view our properties as lasting residential assets that benefit from careful planning, responsible upgrades, and active management.

title: About Us
text:
What We Provide
We provide upgraded residential homes designed for modern urban living. Across our properties, residents can expect an emphasis on:

Functional layouts
Updated infrastructure
Durable materials and finishes
Clean, well-maintained common and private spaces
Long-term ownership and hands-on management

Our goal is to offer housing that is both comfortable for residents and supported by a clear commitment to upkeep and quality.

title: About Us
text:
